rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the money paid to rent something.

example.english: Does the rental here include management fees?
example.traditional: 呢度嘅租金包唔包管理費？
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 zou1 gam1 baau1 m4 baau1 gun2 lei5 fai3

rows.note: Use this for the actual item being rented, such as a car or a flat, rather than the payment.

example.english: I have to return the rental car tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我聽日要還租返嚟嘅架車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 waan4 zou1 faan1 lai4 ge3 gaa3 ce1

rows.note: Use this for a company whose business is renting things out to customers.

example.english: This rental company can help you rent an affordable van.
example.traditional: 呢間出租公司可以幫你租到平價貨車。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 ceot1 zou1 gung1 si1 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 zou1 dou3 ping4 gaa3 fo3 ce1
